payload.text: hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): Molt 1.4.7's cut, stopped on gyges at 13:09Z by three test/liberators/zsh.bats tests whose fixture names its remote host gyges, which is the test host there, is fixed now and resumed on gyges today. molt-dc renames the fixture's remote host; gyges-sysadm puts the fix on top of the release commit 816a1a8 in the scratch clone and runs that file there under both bashes; hv reruns bin/devbin release v1.4.7 in gyges's iTerm2 window before midnight UK time, the stamp's date. hv chose this over cutting 1.4.7 again another day.
